06-email-decline.why: X is tighter, but Y keeps the writer's stated honor at being asked, which X drops.

09-tech-pr-description.why: X is a cleaner PR description, but Y keeps the original's scalability claim, which X drops.

The rewrites differ only in 'looking into it' versus 'digging'.
